# Extended Parameter Ablations and Operational Details

This appendix provides the complete empirical ablation tables referenced in Chapters 2–4—covering the `nsa_flow` trade-off weight $w \in [0.01, 0.95]$, in-fold subject row-mean removal and deterministic ICA initialization, fine-grained quantile sparsity $q \in [\text{None}, 0.90]$, the $1,214$-configuration `ADNI-MCI` grid sweep, synthetic per-regime breakdowns, and pairwise Wilcoxon rank-sum tests—followed by computational complexity bounds.

## Effect of the Approximate Stiefel Weight $w \in [0.01, 0.95]$

@tbl-app-w-sweep and @fig-w-sweep evaluate `SiMLR-LBFGSB` ($\mathbf{V}_m \ge 0, k = 3$) across ten values of $w \in [0.01, 0.95]$ on synthetic `NonnegParts` and clinical `ADNI-MCI` (`Protocol B`).

```{python}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| label: tbl-app-w-sweep
#| tbl-cap: "Sensitivity of basis orthogonality defect $D(V)$, effective rank, sparsity, runtime, and out-of-sample accuracy across ten values of the `nsa_flow` weight $w \\in [0.01, 0.95]$ (`ablation_w_sweep.csv`)."
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import os
import pandas as pd
from tabulate import tabulate

csv_path = "results_cache/ablation_w_sweep.csv"
if not os.path.exists(csv_path):
    csv_path = "paper/results_cache/ablation_w_sweep.csv"

df_w = pd.read_csv(csv_path)
rows = []
for _, r in df_w.iterrows():
    w_str = f"{r['w']:.2f}" + ("*" if abs(r["w"] - 0.50) < 1e-6 else "")
    rows.append([
        w_str,
        f"{r['Synth_Support_F1']:.3f}",
        f"{r['Synth_Defect_D']:.5f}",
        f"{r['Synth_Sparsity']*100:.1f}%",
        f"{r['ADNI_Defect_D']:.5f}",
        f"{r['ADNI_EffRank']:.2f}",
        f"{r['ADNI_Sparsity_All']*100:.1f}%",
        f"{r['ADNI_CogPC1_R2']:.4f}",
        f"{r['ADNI_Fit_Sec']:.2f}s",
    ])

headers = [
    "w", "Synth F1 ↑", "Synth D(V) ↓", "Synth Sparsity ↑",
    "ADNI D(V) ↓", "ADNI EffRank ↑", "ADNI Sparsity ↑", "ADNI CogPC1 R2 ↑", "ADNI Time ↓"
]
print(tabulate(rows, headers=headers, tablefmt="pipe"))
```

```{python}
import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

csv_path = "results_cache/ablation_w_sweep.csv"
if not os.path.exists(csv_path):
    csv_path = "paper/results_cache/ablation_w_sweep.csv"

df_w = pd.read_csv(csv_path)

fig, (ax1, ax2, ax3) = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(13.2, 3.8), dpi=300)
plt.subplots_adjust(wspace=0.72)

# Panel A: Synthetic F1 and Defect D
ax1_t = ax1.twinx()
l1 = ax1.plot(df_w["w"], df_w["Synth_Support_F1"], "o-", color="#0284c7", lw=2.0, markersize=5.5, label="Support F1 ↑")
l2 = ax1_t.plot(df_w["w"], df_w["Synth_Defect_D"], "s--", color="#dc2626", lw=1.8, markersize=5.0, label="Defect D(V) ↓")
ax1_t.set_yscale("log")
ax1.axvline(0.50, color="#64748b", linestyle=":", lw=1.2)
ax1.set_xlabel("Orthogonality Weight w", fontsize=9.0, weight="bold")
ax1.set_ylabel("Support Recovery F1 (↑)", fontsize=8.8, weight="bold", color="#0284c7", labelpad=2)
ax1_t.set_ylabel("Synth Defect D(V) (Log ↓)", fontsize=8.6, weight="bold", color="#dc2626", labelpad=3)
ax1.set_title("A. Synthetic Support vs. D(V)", fontsize=9.5, weight="bold")
ax1.grid(True, linestyle="--", alpha=0.35)

# Panel B: ADNI Defect D and Effective Rank
ax2_t = ax2.twinx()
l3 = ax2.plot(df_w["w"], df_w["ADNI_Defect_D"], "s-", color="#dc2626", lw=2.0, markersize=5.5, label="ADNI D(V) ↓")
l4 = ax2_t.plot(df_w["w"], df_w["ADNI_EffRank"], "^--", color="#0d9488", lw=1.8, markersize=5.5, label="EffRank ↑")
ax2.set_yscale("log")
ax2.axvline(0.50, color="#64748b", linestyle=":", lw=1.2)
ax2.set_xlabel("Orthogonality Weight w", fontsize=9.0, weight="bold")
ax2.set_ylabel("ADNI Defect D(V) (Log ↓)", fontsize=8.6, weight="bold", color="#dc2626", labelpad=2)
ax2_t.set_ylabel("Effective Rank (Max 3.0 ↑)", fontsize=8.6, weight="bold", color="#0d9488", labelpad=3)
ax2_t.set_ylim(2.4, 3.05)
ax2.set_title("B. ADNI Conditioning & Rank", fontsize=9.5, weight="bold")
ax2.grid(True, linestyle="--", alpha=0.35)

# Panel C: ADNI CogPC1 R2 and Sparsity
ax3_t = ax3.twinx()
l5 = ax3.plot(df_w["w"], df_w["ADNI_CogPC1_R2"], "o-", color="#059669", lw=2.0, markersize=5.5, label="CogPC1 R² ↑")
l6 = ax3_t.plot(df_w["w"], df_w["ADNI_Sparsity_v2_k"] * 100.0, "d--", color="#7c3aed", lw=1.8, markersize=5.0, label="Sparsity v₂..ₖ % ↑")
ax3.axvline(0.50, color="#64748b", linestyle=":", lw=1.2)
ax3.set_xlabel("Orthogonality Weight w", fontsize=9.0, weight="bold")
ax3.set_ylabel("ADNI MRI→CogPC1 R² (↑)", fontsize=8.6, weight="bold", color="#059669", labelpad=2)
ax3_t.set_ylabel("Cortical Sparsity v₂..ₖ % (↑)", fontsize=8.6, weight="bold", color="#7c3aed", labelpad=3)
ax3.set_ylim(0.12, 0.20)
ax3.set_title("C. ADNI Stability Plateau", fontsize=9.5, weight="bold")
ax3.grid(True, linestyle="--", alpha=0.35)

plt.show()
```

## Preprocessing Controls: Subject Row-Mean Removal and ICA Initialization

On neuroimaging cohorts where cortical regions share a positive global correlation floor, @tbl-app-rowmean-ica and @fig-rowmean-k-ablation compare standard column centering against in-fold subject row-mean centering, deterministic FastICA [@hyvarinen2000independent] initialization, and latent rank scaling $k \in \{2, 3, 5, 8, 12\}$.

```{python}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| label: tbl-app-rowmean-ica
#| tbl-cap: "Factorial ablation of column vs. subject row-mean centering, PCA vs. ICA initialization, and positivity constraints on `ADNI-MCI` ($N = 1,084, k = 3, w = 0.50$, `ablation_rowmean_ica_positivity.csv`)."
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import os
import pandas as pd
from tabulate import tabulate

csv_path = "results_cache/ablation_rowmean_ica_positivity.csv"
if not os.path.exists(csv_path):
    csv_path = "paper/results_cache/ablation_rowmean_ica_positivity.csv"

df_abl = pd.read_csv(csv_path)
rows = []
for _, r in df_abl.iterrows():
    prep_short = "Col" if r["Preprocessing"].startswith("Col") else "Row+Col"
    pos_short = "Signed" if r["Positivity"].startswith("Signed") else "V>=0"
    stage_short = "Init" if r["Stage"].startswith("Init") else "SiMR"
    rows.append([
        prep_short,
        r["Init"],
        pos_short,
        stage_short,
        f"{r['defect_D']:.5f}",
        f"{r['sparsity_all']*100:.1f}% ({r['sparsity_v1']*100:.1f}%)",
        f"{r['CogPC1_R2_XV']:.4f} ({r['CogPC1_R2_WithRowMean']:.4f})",
        f"{r['Mean11_Ridge_R2']:.4f}",
    ])

headers = [
    "Prep", "Init", "Sign", "Stage", "D(V) ↓",
    "Sparsity All (v1) ↑", "CogPC1 R2 (+RowMean) ↑", "11-Scale R2 ↑"
]
print(tabulate(rows, headers=headers, tablefmt="pipe"))
```

```{python}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| label: fig-rowmean-k-ablation
#| fig-cap: "Resolution of the unthresholded `ADNI-MCI` Component 1 density effect via subject row-mean removal and latent rank scaling (`ablation_rowmean_ica_positivity.csv` and `ablation_k_sparsity_sweep.csv`). (A) Under unthresholded column centering (`q = None`), Component 1 ($v_1$, blue) absorbs the global cortical thickness floor ($3.2\\%$ sparse) while Components $2..k$ ($v_2..v_k$, teal) remain $21.0\\%$ sparse; removing each subject's mean cortical thickness or applying quantile thresholding ($q = 0.80$) restores $53.2\\%$–$81.5\\%$ sparsity on $v_1$. (B) Scaling latent rank $k \\in \\{2, 3, 5, 8, 12\\}$ systematically increases natural unthresholded non-negative sparsity toward the theoretical disjoint limit $1 - 1/k$."
#| out-width: 100%
#| echo: false
import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

csv_k = "results_cache/ablation_k_sparsity_sweep.csv"
if not os.path.exists(csv_k):
    csv_k = "paper/results_cache/ablation_k_sparsity_sweep.csv"
df_k = pd.read_csv(csv_k)

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11.2, 4.0), dpi=300, constrained_layout=True)

# Panel A: Component 1 vs Components 2..k Sparsity across 5 regimes
regimes = [
    "Col + PCA\n(q = None)",
    "Col + ICA\n(q = None)",
    "Row + PCA\n(q = None)",
    "Row + ICA\n(q = None)",
    "Col + PCA\n(q = 0.80)"
]
v1_sp = [3.2, 46.8, 53.2, 62.9, 81.5]
v2k_sp = [21.0, 29.0, 62.9, 60.5, 84.7]

x = np.arange(len(regimes))
w = 0.34
b1 = ax1.bar(x - w/2, v1_sp, w, label="Component 1 (v₁ Sparsity %)", color="#0284c7", edgecolor="#0f172a", lw=0.7)
b2 = ax1.bar(x + w/2, v2k_sp, w, label="Components 2..k (v₂..ₖ Sparsity %)", color="#0d9488", edgecolor="#0f172a", lw=0.7)

for bars in (b1, b2):
    for bar in bars:
        h = bar.get_height()
        ax1.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, h + 1.2, f"{h:.1f}%", ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=7.5, weight="bold")

ax1.set_xticks(x)
ax1.set_xticklabels(regimes, fontsize=8.3, weight="bold")
ax1.set_ylim(0, 96)
ax1.set_ylabel("Cortical Basis Sparsity % (↑)", fontsize=9.2, weight="bold")
ax1.set_title("A. Component 1 vs. Components 2..k Sparsity", fontsize=9.8, weight="bold")
ax1.grid(True, axis="y", linestyle="--", alpha=0.35)
ax1.legend(loc="upper left", fontsize=8.2, frameon=True)

# Panel B: Latent Rank k Sweep
for prep_lbl, col, mk in [("Col-Centered (PCA Init)", "#0284c7", "o-"), ("Row-Centered (ICA Init)", "#059669", "s--")]:
    sub_k = df_k[df_k["Regime"] == prep_lbl]
    ax2.plot(sub_k["k"], sub_k["Sparsity_All"] * 100.0, mk, color=col, lw=2.1, markersize=6.5, label=f"{prep_lbl} All v₁..ₖ")
    ax2.plot(sub_k["k"], sub_k["Sparsity_v2_k"] * 100.0, ":", color=col, lw=1.7, markersize=5.0, label=f"{prep_lbl} v₂..ₖ Only")

ax2.set_xticks([2, 3, 5, 8, 12])
ax2.set_xticklabels(["k=2", "k=3", "k=5", "k=8", "k=12"], fontsize=8.5, weight="bold")
ax2.set_ylim(30, 90)
ax2.set_xlabel("Latent Embedding Rank k", fontsize=9.2, weight="bold")
ax2.set_ylabel("Unthresholded Sparsity % (↑)", fontsize=9.2, weight="bold")
ax2.set_title("B. Natural Non-Negative Sparsity vs. Rank k", fontsize=9.8, weight="bold")
ax2.grid(True, linestyle="--", alpha=0.35)
ax2.legend(loc="lower right", fontsize=7.8, frameon=True)

plt.show()
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import os
import pandas as pd
from tabulate import tabulate

csv_path = "results_cache/adni_mci_1214_grid_sweep.csv"
if not os.path.exists(csv_path):
    csv_path = "paper/results_cache/adni_mci_1214_grid_sweep.csv"

df_sw = pd.read_csv(csv_path)
df_sw["Model"] = df_sw["Model"].replace({"Flow-SiMLR-V": "Flow-SiMR-V"})
df_ok = df_sw[df_sw["Status"] == "ok"].copy()

best_per_model = df_ok.sort_values("CogPC1_R2", ascending=False).groupby("Model", as_index=False).first()
best_per_model = best_per_model.sort_values("CogPC1_R2", ascending=False)
stats_per_model = df_ok.groupby("Model").agg(n_runs=("CogPC1_R2", "count"), mean_r2=("CogPC1_R2", "mean"), std_r2=("CogPC1_R2", "std"))

rows = []
for _, r in best_per_model.iterrows():
    m = r["Model"]
    n_r = int(stats_per_model.loc[m, "n_runs"])
    m_r2 = stats_per_model.loc[m, "mean_r2"]
    s_r2 = stats_per_model.loc[m, "std_r2"]
    mean_str = f"{m_r2:.3f} ± {s_r2:.3f}" if pd.notnull(s_r2) else f"{m_r2:.3f}"
    rows.append([
        r["Family"],
        m,
        n_r,
        f"{r['CogPC1_R2']:.4f}",
        f"{r['Mean11_RidgeCV']:.4f}",
        mean_str,
        f"{r['Runtime_s']:.2f}s"
    ])

headers = ["Family", "Model", "Runs", "Peak CogPC1 R2 ↑", "11-Scale R2 ↑", "Sweep Mean ± SD ↑", "Time ↓"]
print(tabulate(rows, headers=headers, tablefmt="pipe"))
```

## Synthetic Per-Regime Breakdown and Pairwise Wilcoxon Tests

@tbl-app-synthetic-breakdown and @fig-cmc-recovery report the 3-seed performance across each of the six synthetic ground-truth regimes, and @tbl-app-wilcoxon reports pairwise Wilcoxon signed-rank tests against `PCA` across the $N = 36$ dataset-seed pairs.

```{python}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| label: tbl-app-synthetic-breakdown
#| tbl-cap: "Out-of-sample performance across the six synthetic ground-truth regimes (`deep_ranking_benchmark.csv`). Entries show `Linear XV R2 (CMC or Support F1)`."
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import os
import pandas as pd
from tabulate import tabulate

csv_path = "results_cache/deep_ranking_benchmark.csv"
if not os.path.exists(csv_path):
    csv_path = "paper/results_cache/deep_ranking_benchmark.csv"

df = pd.read_csv(csv_path)
df["Model"] = df["Model"].replace({"Flow-SiMLR-V": "Flow-SiMR-V", "Flow-SiMLR": "Flow-SiMR"})

models = ["SiMLR-LBFGSB", "SiMLR-LBFGS", "LEND", "Flow-SiMR-V", "SiMLR", "NSAFlow-PCA", "PCA", "NEDPP", "NED"]
syn_dsets = ["Linear", "Polynomial", "Sine", "Shared+Private", "NonnegParts", "NonnegPartsWeak"]

rows = []
for m in models:
    row = [m]
    for ds in syn_dsets:
        sub = df[(df["Dataset"] == ds) & (df["Model"] == m)]
        xv_m = sub["Strictly_Linear_Metric"].mean()
        if ds in ("NonnegParts", "NonnegPartsWeak"):
            s_m = sub["Support_Recovery_V"].mean()
            row.append(f"{xv_m:.3f} (F1={s_m:.2f})")
        else:
            c_m = sub["CMC_Latent_U"].mean()
            row.append(f"{xv_m:.3f} (CMC={c_m:.2f})")
    rows.append(row)

headers = ["Model", "Linear", "Polynomial", "Sine", "Shared+Priv", "NonnegParts", "NonnegWeak"]
print(tabulate(rows, headers=headers, tablefmt="pipe"))
```

```{python}
import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

piv_c = df[df["Dataset"].isin(syn_dsets)].pivot_table(index="Dataset", columns="Model", values="CMC_Latent_U", aggfunc="mean").reindex(syn_dsets)

ax.set_xticks(x)

ax.set_title("Ground-Truth Latent Coordinate Recovery Across Six Synthetic Regimes", fontsize=10.2, weight="bold")
ax.set_ylim(0.0, 1.05)
ax.grid(True, axis="y", linestyle="--", alpha=0.35)
ax.legend(loc="upper right", ncol=4, fontsize=8.3, frameon=True)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| label: tbl-app-wilcoxon
#| tbl-cap: "Pairwise Wilcoxon signed-rank tests and win/tie/loss counts against single-matrix `PCA` across all 36 dataset-seed evaluations (`deep_ranking_benchmark.csv`)."
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import wilcoxon
from tabulate import tabulate

csv_path = "results_cache/deep_ranking_benchmark.csv"
if not os.path.exists(csv_path):
    csv_path = "paper/results_cache/deep_ranking_benchmark.csv"

df = pd.read_csv(csv_path)
df["Model"] = df["Model"].replace({"Flow-SiMLR-V": "Flow-SiMR-V", "Flow-SiMLR": "Flow-SiMR"})

piv_xv = df.pivot(index=["Dataset", "Seed"], columns="Model", values="Strictly_Linear_Metric")
piv_u = df.pivot(index=["Dataset", "Seed"], columns="Model", values="Predictive_Metric")

models = ["LEND", "NEDPP", "Flow-SiMR-V", "SiMLR-LBFGS", "SiMLR-LBFGSB", "NED", "SiMLR", "NSAFlow-PCA"]
rows = []
for m in models:
    diff_xv = piv_xv[m] - piv_xv["PCA"]
    w_xv = int((diff_xv > 1e-6).sum())
    t_xv = int((diff_xv.abs() <= 1e-6).sum())
    l_xv = int((diff_xv < -1e-6).sum())
    _, p_xv = wilcoxon(piv_xv[m], piv_xv["PCA"])

    diff_u = piv_u[m] - piv_u["PCA"]
    w_u = int((diff_u > 1e-6).sum())
    t_u = int((diff_u.abs() <= 1e-6).sum())
    l_u = int((diff_u < -1e-6).sum())
    _, p_u = wilcoxon(piv_u[m], piv_u["PCA"])

    rows.append([
        m,
        f"{w_xv} / {t_xv} / {l_xv}",
        f"{diff_xv.mean():+.4f}",
        f"{p_xv:.4f}",
        f"{w_u} / {t_u} / {l_u}",
        f"{diff_u.mean():+.4f}",
        f"{p_u:.4f}",
    ])

headers = [
    "Model vs PCA", "XV Wins/Ties/Losses", "XV Mean Δ ↑", "XV Wilcoxon p",
    "U Wins/Ties/Losses", "U Mean Δ ↑", "U Wilcoxon p"
]
print(tabulate(rows, headers=headers, tablefmt="pipe"))
```

## Computational Complexity Summary

| Operation | Complexity per Iteration | Memory Footprint | Inner-Loop Factorization Required? |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **`nsa_flow` Retraction Step** | $\mathcal{O}(p_m k^2)$ | $\mathcal{O}(p_m k + k^2)$ | None (1 Gram product + 2 $[p_m,k]\times[k,k]$ products) |
| **Polar Consensus Update ($\mathbf{U}$)** | $\mathcal{O}(N k^2 + k^3)$ | $\mathcal{O}(N k)$ | $k \times k$ Sylvester polar factor ($k \ll N$) |
| **Forward / Backward Pass** | $\mathcal{O}(N p_m k)$ | $\mathcal{O}(N k + p_m k)$ | None |
